name: openspec-workflows-token-opt
description: Measurement harness for the brainspec-slim token-reduction experiment. The harness runs a scripted workload through the original `brainspec-*` skills (baseline) and the new `brainspec-slim-*` skills (optimized), produces a session JSONL for each, and verifies that the optimized run reduces process-management tokens by >= 30% versus the baseline.
